_what: THE shared lip-sync recipe -- single source of truth for DropCat-Studio (features/song_video) and DCMVS-restored (chain.py). Change values ONLY with a LIPSYNC_LEDGER.md entry + evidence, per the ledger's own rule.
_provenance: Assembled 2026-08-04 late night from LIPSYNC_LEDGER.md CURRENT RECIPE (verified against live code the same night) after the blind-label session vindicated end_anchor=true 6/6. DCS enforces parity via tests/test_recipe.py; DCMVS wiring is a flagged next step (see dcmvs section).

model.name: ltx2_distilled
model.local_patch_note: THREE dirty files, not two -- the third (TeaCache keys) is inert for LTX-2 but must be copied for true parity. Folder names are INVERTED between boxes; never reason by path name.

render.actual_note: LTX-2 ceil-rounds to 64-multiples: 960x544 RENDERS AS 960x512. 1024x576 is the untested exact-16:9 candidate.
render.guidance_note: Distilled FORCES guidance to 1.0 internally -- 3.0 is passed because audio_cfg mirrors it, and THAT passes through.
render.end_anchor_note: Blind-labeled 6/6 on 2026-08-04: all three anchor-ON takes GOOD, all three anchor-OFF BAD (camera push-in + identity morph). Vindicated; do not flip without new human labels.

frames.grip_note: Audio conditioning stops gripping past ~250 frames; renders fine, silently stops syncing. Content budget = ceiling minus trim+crossfade overhead (0.40s = 10f at 24fps). The site pipeline's budget is 236 because its overhead differs -- do not copy numbers across engines, copy the RULE.

assembly.rule: headroom-then-trim for fresh renders; pad-with-clones only for SE-anchored already-rendered material

conditioning_audio.source: isolated vocal stem, NEVER the raw mix
conditioning_audio.phrase_gate: silero, 0.18s soft ramps, SILENT slice for zero-phrase windows, over-mute breaker >85%
conditioning_audio.energy_assert: every conditioning input asserts energy AT CREATION -- whole stem and per slice; a silent guide aborts loudly (2026-08-04 rule, three incidents)

acceptance.ribbon_note: Three bands: p95 below clean = accept, above infested = reject, between = eye-check. The ledger's 'p95 < 0.30' line describes the CLEAN band only. The ONE metric validated at both ends; red-strand and glyph detectors are eye-screens only, never gates.
acceptance.sync_enforce_note: DISARMED 2026-08-04: the floor was inverted against Andrew's blind labels (his approved takes score 0.001; his rejects clear the floor). Advisory logging only until a scorer is recalibrated against human labels. Re-arm ONLY in the same commit as that recalibration.
acceptance.scorer_status: mouth_sync_score + total_motion are whole-frame, unmasked, no ROI -- neither may gate or auto-select. Replacement metric (aperture-during-voiced) v1 discarded for ROI drift; needs per-frame head re-detection.

tiers.format_note: Andrew 2026-08-04 ~22:55: 30 seconds for EVERYONE -- superseded his own 60s-admin spec from ~21:00. Tiers differ only in take budget.

3060.note: UNMEASURED -- fit test (144f, production recipe, anchor ON) pending; fill max_safe_pixels from its result, enforce via _clamp_res_for_gpu

dcmvs.status: NOT YET WIRED -- chain.py still carries its own constants. Known divergences to reconcile when wired: FRAMES_PER_CLIP=481 (predates the 249 grip ceiling; runs override per-call), CROSSFADE_SEC=0.0 (DCS assembles at 0.12), INPUT_VIDEO_STRENGTH=None (worker falls back to 0.69), SEEDS_PER_CLIP=1 (best-of driven by CLI).
